audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 gave the stage to Poppy in both layers while their whys read 'stays even as neither champion has a real kill threat yet' and 'still skill-based'. Row 3 read Skill while its why says 'your Q and E out-damage a squishy Poppy and win the extended trade', and its rating sat at 4/10.
audit.why: Poppy has almost no damage before her first tank item; levels 4-5 are the one clean Zaahen window before she out-durables him. The packet chart reads Skill / Skill / Skill / Zaahen / Skill / Poppy / Poppy and the mirror audit already flipped rows 1, 2 and 3 and dropped the 4-5 rating to match.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Skill, row 3 to Zaahen, all as matched full/content pairs, plus phases[3].rating raised from 4/10 to 6/10 so the number stops contradicting the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict was described as something that 'can cancel your engage or ult you away' with no cooldown and no mention that it is itself a channel.
audit.why: It is 140s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in the lane — and Riot's text has her CHANNEL the strike. Zaahen holds two displacements (the Q recast knockup and the 850-range W pull), either of which ends the channel before it fires. That reverses the advice: you do not avoid her ult, you interrupt it.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten around the 140s channel and cancelling it with displacement; the same fact carried into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Steadfast Presence's 20s cooldown was never stated even though the entire page is built on 'fight when her W is down'. Heroic Charge's wall condition was mentioned only as a don't-title with an unrelated body, and 'E Golden Onslaught' is not one of Zaahen's abilities.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12 — 20s at rank 1 is an enormous window and the concrete reason the advice works. Riot's text also says a stopped dash is then slowed AND grounded, so a failed E costs more than the dash. Heroic Charge only stuns if it pushes you into a wall, at 475 range, which makes standing in open ground a real instruction rather than a slogan. Iron Ambassador's buckler gives her a shield only if she retrieves it.
audit.corrected: 20s written into spikes[0], mid, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; Heroic Charge's wall condition and 14s into spikes[3], breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d; the buckler pickup into early. Fabricated E name replaced with a slot reference.

edits.before: Poppy is a low-early-damage tank whose lane threat is her W Steadfast Presence dash-block and Hammer Shock zone; the early trades are skill-based, but by levels 4-5 your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught out-damage her and you win the extended fight.
edits.after: Poppy is a low-early-damage tank whose lane threat is Steadfast Presence (W) — 20s at rank 1, and it stops your E dash outright, then slows and grounds you. Early trades are skill-based, but at 4-5 your Q and E out-damage her if you dash only after that W is spent.

edits.before: Poppy R Keeper's Verdict can cancel your engage or ult you away, so her disengage and pick threat rises at 6; don't commit E Golden Onslaught into a charged Verdict that resets the fight in her favour.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (R) is a channel on 140s at rank 1 — your Q recast knockup or your 850-range W pull cancels it outright. Whoever lands displacement first owns this trade, so hold one for her channel, not for chip.

edits.before: Poppy scales into a tanky duelist and peel machine whose W blocks your dashes and E pins you to walls; you won't win the 1v1 late, so play tempo and objectives rather than fighting into her wall-pin combo.
edits.after: Poppy scales into a tanky duelist whose W stops your dash and whose E only stuns if it pushes you into a wall, so fight in open ground away from the lane's edges. You will not win the late 1v1 — play tempo and objectives.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are an even farm start; Poppy has little early damage and just wants to CS behind W Steadfast Presence. Neither side has a clean kill this early, so play the wave and look for your spike.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are an even farm start; Poppy has little early damage and just wants to CS. Her buckler only shields her if she picks it back up, so step on it before she can. Neither side has a clean kill this early.

edits.before: Levels 3 stays skill-based, but at levels 4-5 you spike: your Q Darkin Glaive and E Golden Onslaught out-damage a still-squishy Poppy, so that's your window to trade before her tank items and R Keeper's Verdict start swinging fights her way at 6.
edits.after: Level 3 stays skill-based, but at levels 4-5 you spike: your Q and E out-damage a still-squishy Poppy. That is your window — dash in only once the 20s Steadfast Presence is spent, and trade before her tank items and Keeper's Verdict swing fights at 6.

edits.before: - Poppy Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — Grounds you — disables your dashes. Wait it out. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Steadfast Presence (W): matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1; it stops your dash, then slows and grounds. Dash after it, never into it. - Heroic Charge (E): 14s, stuns you against a wall. - Keeper's Verdict (R): a 140s channel — displacement cancels it.

edits.before: Grounds you — disables your dashes. Wait it out. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It stops your dash and then grounds you, 20s at rank 1. Engage after it is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her E stuns only if a wall is behind you — fight in open ground.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — land your Q knockup or W pull first and it never goes off at all.

edits.before: Track Poppy's Steadfast Presence: Grounds you — disables your dashes. Wait it out. When it is down — Combo + R her.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops your dash and grounds you, 20s at rank 1. Your displacement cancels her R channel.

notes: Poppy's W is the one place in this champion's data where the 'grounding' derived flag matches Riot's own description exactly ('stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded'), so it is asserted with confidence here — unlike the Ornn/Olaf/Mordekaiser flags I declined. tradeGood, breakdown.feeding and report[12].t still call Poppy 'his'/'he'; she is female. Those are long strings whose only fault is the pronoun, so they need a scripted pass rather than a length-band rewrite.
